## Ontario Tenant Dispute Timeline Overview

A clean way to visualize this case is as a dated dispute timeline: lease start, rent change, repair notice, landlord reply, then hearing.
This is informational only and should be used to organize documents and questions, not as legal advice.

## Case Timeline Chart Concept and Hearing Prep

## Timeline Chart Concept
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/calendar-event.svg

- 2024-08-01 — Lease begins
- 2025-02-01 — Rent increase takes effect
- 2025-03-12 — Tenant sends repair request
- 2025-03-20 — Landlord replies
- 2025-06-05 — Hearing date

Chart concept for UI:
- X-axis: date
- Y-axis: event type
- Use color tags:
  - Lease event
  - Rent issue
  - Repair issue
  - Response
  - Hearing milestone
- Add callouts for documents attached to each date

## Key Facts and Evidence Checklist

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/journal-check.svg

- Lease and tenancy agreement showing start date and rent terms
- Rent increase notice, including date received and effective date
- Proof of prior rent amount and new rent amount
- Repair request sent on 2025-03-12
- Landlord reply on 2025-03-20
- Photos or videos of unresolved repairs, dated if possible
- Maintenance logs, work orders, contractor notes, or follow-up emails
- Rent payment records before and after 2025-02-01
- Any messages showing delays, refusals, or partial repairs
- Notes of phone calls: date, time, person spoken to, and what was said
- Hearing materials organized in date order with a short summary page

## Settlement vs. Hearing Comparison

| Path | Pros | Cons |
|---|---|---|
| Settlement | Faster resolution; may reduce stress; can address rent and repairs together | May require compromise; terms must be written clearly; no guaranteed full remedy |
| Hearing | Formal decision process; can create a record; may resolve disputed facts | Takes more time; preparation is heavier; outcome is uncertain |

## Practical Next Steps for the File

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/folder2-open.svg

- Build one folder per issue: rent increase, repairs, communications, payment history
- Create a one-page chronology with dates, events, and attached evidence
- Highlight what changed on 2025-02-01 and what remained unresolved after 2025-03-20
- Prepare a short list of requested outcomes for either settlement or hearing
- Keep copies of everything in both PDF and original format if available

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Review Ontario tenancy rules] https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/
Action: [Button: Organize evidence checklist] https://www.ontario.ca/page/renting-ontario-your-rights
Action: [Button: Hearing prep guide] https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/hearings/

## Sources

- Tribunals Ontario - Landlord and Tenant Board: https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/
- Ontario government - Renting in Ontario: https://www.ontario.ca/page/renting-ontario-your-rights
- Tribunals Ontario - Hearings: https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/hearings/
